sentences: A standard extractor turns weak randomness into near-uniform bits under its source assumptions.
The cited question asks whether standard extractors can also be used to construct non-malleable extractors.
Non-malleability requires output to remain useful even when an adversary creates related, tampered inputs or seeds.
A general transformation would connect an established randomness primitive to the stronger guarantees needed in adversarial settings.
The saved sentence does not fix the source or tampering model, so the two-source and affine variants named by the paper must be distinguished when stating an actual reduction.
